description: The agent must: (1) Locate SKILL.md at /workspace/skills/hk_data/SKILL.md and derive the run.py path from it. (2) Call `python /workspace/skills/hk_data/run.py hk-view --hk_code 02318.HK` — note the parameter is `--hk_code` (underscore), not `--trade_code`. (3) Call `python /workspace/skills/hk_data/run.py hk-valuatnanalyd --trade_code 02318.HK --page 1 --page_size 20` to retrieve PE TTM=9.87, PB=1.23, PS=0.87, dividend_yield=5.12. (4) Call `python /workspace/skills/hk_data/run.py hk-candlesticks --trade-code 02318.HK --interval-unit day --until-date 2026-03-24 --since-date 2026-03-01 --limit 20` — critically, the candlestick flags use hyphens (`--trade-code`, `--interval-unit`, `--until-date`, `--since-date`) while other sub-skills use underscores. (5) Merge all three responses into a single research_report.json file. The proprietary traps are: the inconsistent underscore vs hyphen convention between sub-skills, the `--hk_code` vs `--trade_code` distinction for hk-view, and the mandatory `--until-date` for candlesticks.
